validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE (vs P7315, the roster's own flagged watchlist pair): CONFIRMED real, and CONFIRMED as two phases of one project, not a duplicate. Egypt Oil & Gas (egyptoil-gas.com, 18 Jan 2024) reports on a Petroleum Ministry review: 'the new line from the Sokhna area to the Ajroud area in Suez, the first phase of which was completed with a length of 35 km, and the second phase with a length of 65 km is being implemented ... in order to trade and transport crude oil.' 35 km = P7331 (this row), 65 km = P7315 (Agroud-Ain Sokhna Oil Pipeline, roster's other entry) -- an exact match on both lengths and on GEM's own internal segmentation: the worklist's own segment_name for this row is 'Agroud-Wadi Hagool (Pipeline 1)', i.e. GEM already models this as the Agroud-to-Wadi-Hagool leg. A supporting web search independently surfaced that Egypt's environmental authority issued SEPARATE approvals for a 'Agroud-Wadi Hagool' line and a 'Wadi Hagool-Sokhna' line (two distinct construction permits), consistent with two physically distinct pipe segments rather than one line entered twice. Wadi Hagool itself is a real, well-documented valley on the Cairo/Suez-Ain Sokhna corridor (bridge, highway landmark), a plausible physical midpoint. Per the scope guidance's own rule of thumb (same name + same length + same diameter is the suspicious case; different lengths under a shared corridor name usually means real parallel/sequential segments), P7331 (35 km, Phase 1) and P7315 (65 km, Phase 2) are DIFFERENT lengths and represent sequential construction phases of one corridor -- keep both rows, not a duplicate.

validity.researcher_notes: STATUS is the sharpest finding on this row. egyptoil-gas.com (18 Jan 2024) states Phase 1 (35 km, this row) 'was completed' while Phase 2 (65 km, P7315) 'is being implemented' -- i.e. as of Jan 2024 the source already distinguishes a FINISHED 35 km phase from a STILL-UNDER-CONSTRUCTION 65 km phase. GEM's sheet has BOTH P7331 and P7315 at status=construction as of a 2026-02-11 update, two-plus years later. I could not find a 2025/2026 source explicitly confirming P7331 is now flowing oil (operating) -- construction 'completed' is not necessarily the same as commissioned/operating, and Egyptian infrastructure projects do slip -- so I am not proposing an outright status change without a source that names this row's operational state as of 2025/2026. But 'construction' as the CURRENT (2026) status for the 35 km phase, sourced only to a ref that does not even mention this pipeline (see the next validity item), is unsupported and should be treated as an open question, not settled data. Two more general July-2024 sources (menbareltahrir.com and elwatannews.com/news/details/7448637, both dated 2024-07-22 and using near-identical wording from what reads as the same press event/tour) track ongoing 'Phase Two' execution-status monitoring only -- they say nothing new about Phase One's status either way, and are not independent of each other (do not count them as two separate corroborating sources for anything).

validity.researcher_notes: MISCITATION found on the current ref for Fuel/PipelineType/Status. https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/5906989 is dated 2022-01-16 (fetched and read the full article text) and reports the opening of a monitoring/control room for the Suez-Canal petroleum pipeline network. It lists a FIVE-YEAR PLAN of aspirational future projects presented by PPC's chairman, including: lines linking Ras Bidran/Gharib/Shaqir crude depots to the national crude network, a line linking the Sokhna line to the Upper-Egypt network, a line linking the Wagh Bahari/Delta area to Upper Egypt/Suez/Musturad, and -- the only Agroud/Sokhna-adjacent item -- 'a pipeline linking the Ajroud and Sokhna DEPOTS to MUSTURAD' (Arabic: 'إنشاء خط أنابيب لربط مستودعات عجرود والسخنة بمسطرد'). That is a DIFFERENT destination (Musturad) than this row's endpoint (Ain Sokhna/Suez Gulf) -- it more plausibly corresponds to the roster's 'Suez-Musturad' rows (P7332/P7337) than to the Agroud-Ain Sokhna pipeline. The word 'construction' (or any Arabic equivalent) never appears for this specific segment; this is consistent with the sheet's own automated ref-check on this cell, which already flagged '200 but data value not found (none of [\'construction\'])'. I verified this directly: fetched the live page (curl, since WebFetch itself returned 403 -- confirmed via url_verifier that the cited page loads at 200 but does not contain the expected token), confirmed via the JSON-LD dateline it is a 2022-01-16 article, and located the one relevant passage myself. Fuel=Oil and PipelineType=transmission are still independently plausible (this is unambiguously a crude-oil trunk line per egyptoil-gas.com), but the CITED source for those two cells does not actually support them for this specific pipeline -- it's a generic five-year-plan mention of a different route.

validity.recommendation: Diameter=36in is plausible but only directly documented for Phase 2 (P7315, 65 km), not for this 35 km Phase-1 row. Leave as-is (same-trunk inference is reasonable) but do not treat it as independently confirmed for this specific segment.
validity.researcher_notes: The current Diameter/StartLocation/EndLocation ref (menbareltahrir.com, 22 Jul 2024, verified live and on-topic) explicitly documents ONLY 'the second phase of the 36-inch strategic line (Ajroud-Sokhna station)' (Arabic: 'المرحلة الثانية للخط 36 بوصة استراتيجى (عجرود – محطة السخنة)'). That is Phase 2 = P7315 (65 km), not this row (Phase 1, 35 km) -- the source never states Phase 1's diameter. It is a reasonable engineering inference that a single continuous crude-oil trunk keeps one diameter across both of its construction phases, so I am not flagging this as a hard error, but the cited source is being used to support a claim (this row's diameter) one degree removed from what it actually says. StartLocation=Agroud and EndLocation=Ain Sokhna/Suez Gulf are directionally consistent with all sources found (egyptoil-gas.com, the environmental-approval search snippet naming 'Agroud-Wadi Hagool' and 'Wadi Hagool-Sokhna' as the two permitted segments) even though sources alternate between calling the corridor 'Sokhna-Ajroud' and 'Ajroud-Sokhna' -- normal for a bidirectional crude trunk description, not treated as an endpoint error. Note: an identically-worded elwatannews.com article (news/details/7448637, same 22 Jul 2024 date) reports the same Phase-2 fact -- it is the SAME press event/wire text as menbareltahrir.com, not an independent second source; don't double-count it.

summary: P7331 is real and correctly kept distinct from P7315 (confirmed two-phase project, 35 km Phase 1 + 65 km Phase 2, not a duplicate); but its Fuel/PipelineType/Status ref (elwatannews 5906989) is a miscitation describing a different route (Ajroud+Sokhna->Musturad, 2022 five-year-plan mention), and Status=construction is stale/unconfirmed since the best on-point source already called this 35 km phase 'completed' in Jan 2024 -- flagged as open, not changed outright. Diameter=36in is directly sourced only for Phase 2, not this row.
